season.evidence: Park route brief and guide pages: climbers go early (May-June) before warm weather exposes loose rock; logged Liberty Ridge ascents May-Jul; stored May-Jul.

track.why: Logged route 'Liberty Ridge' (descent Emmons), Jul 2 2017, summited, report says camped at Thumb Rock; line passes within about 40 m of our Thumb Rock pin; starts and ends 16/119 m from the White River pin; summit 36 m.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Jun 6 2018 summited complete track passing near Thumb Rock, but no route name.
Jul 2 2023, summited, no route name, line stays ~1.4 km from Thumb Rock so probably not Liberty Ridge (may be Ptarmigan); not assigned to either.

facts.text: In early June the Carbon Glacier crossing can be badly broken; one party reported three teams ahead turning around before finding a way through.
In late May the established tracks dropped low on the Winthrop Glacier below its icefall, which avoided the big crevasses on the way to the lower Curtis Ridge.

season.evidence: Mountaineers route page lists May, June, July; a park ranger blog says it is usually climbed before the end of June; logged Ptarmigan Ridge ascents in May and July.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Logged Ptarmigan Ridge, May 28 2018, but no track points harvested.
Unnamed; could be Ptarmigan or another line; not assigned.

facts.text: Late May: the traverse between the two snow aprons can be bare, with a strip of thin verglas then frozen mud needing delicate frontpointing.
Late May: the ridge leading to the 10,300 ft bivy was melted out, a crumbly knife edge best bypassed on snow just east of the crest.
Rockfall rises quickly once sun hits the hourglass area; a night at the 10,300 ft bivy and an early start let you climb it in shade.

notes: 2234902 fits neither route clearly. Summit pins are within 45 m of the tracks' highest points and about 36 m of the surveyed coordinate; no move.
